# Vilizar Denichin

> Portfolio of Vilizar Denichin, a Front-End Developer based in Dunstable, UK, specialising in React, TypeScript, Next.js, accessibility, responsive interfaces and automated testing.

## Portfolio

- [Homepage](https://vilizar.dev/): Overview of Vilizar Denichin's front-end development work, skills and contact details.
- [About](https://vilizar.dev/#about): Background, development strengths and working approach.
- [Selected Work](https://vilizar.dev/#work): Featured client and personal projects.
- [Contact](https://vilizar.dev/#contact): Contact and professional links.
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://vilizar.dev/cv/vilizar-denichin-cv.pdf): Downloadable CV.

## Project Case Studies

- [Euphoria Wellness Studio](https://vilizar.dev/projects/euphoria-wellness): Production bilingual wellness studio website with responsive media, booking enquiry form, technical SEO and automated tests.
- [DevQuiz](https://vilizar.dev/projects/devquiz): Developer quiz application with a secure server-side API proxy, resilient error handling and Vitest and Playwright tests.
- [Workout Builder](https://vilizar.dev/projects/workout-builder): Seven-day workout planner with custom exercises, persistent browser state and automated tests.
- [CineVault](https://vilizar.dev/projects/cinevault): TMDB-powered movie discovery application with filtering, sorting and automated tests.
